entities.summary: Stas Mikhaylov (b. 1969-04-27, Sochi) was a journalist or media commentator of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Sochi and Russia. Known in the fields of russia, poets & playwrights, europe.
